label: What discriminates will from chance at a necessary source with an invariant set-up?
summary: See docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md sections 5-8. Verified zero-axiom results: A b5b84276 (intellect and one power make every giving willed), B 963e9689 (the withholding holder is a willed two-way giver given its intellect and one power), C 51ea3a40 (restricted Theta 5 principle DNP_inv gives will to invariant two-way givers), D bc4d81f6 (GOD_4 HAS_WILL_1 from the GOD_4 holder bridge, #1897 creator premises and C's conclusion), E 16002747 (DNP-prime implies DNP_inv; strengthens registered, strictness in the controls). Controls ec6627bf: the flip law (only Rational separates a willed from a CHANCE_3 giver), DNP-prime and DNP_inv are, with excluded middle, exactly the denial of CHANCE_3 in their scope (law 11), and the chance core (law 13: one power, CHANCE_3, intellect, will-follows-intellect and will-as-rational-power inconsistent, each member needed). So the Theta 5 route adds no discriminating information against the chance rival beyond DNP_inv's own warrant. At a source with one power, intellect with will-follows-intellect and will-as-a-rational-power suffices to make the giving willed and the chance rival must deny the source's intellect; the converse is not proved (Rational has no content), and other warrants for will at the source that are independent of DNP_inv (e.g. the Fifth Way and governor routes, given the holder-root identification) would discriminate equally (law 6) (argument D is not one: its will comes from DNP_inv, exactly the denial of CHANCE_3), so by this route the case for willed giving is at most as strong as intellect, one power and the holder-root identification together. Rejected candidate warrants for DNP_inv: 'chance needs a varying set-up' (that is CHANCE_2 and begs the question); q.19 a.4's determination argument (it is the intellect/exemplar question, not a separate warrant); Physics II.6, chance posterior to intellect and nature (it targets incidental chance, CHANCE_1). Read ST I q.19 a.4 in the materialized witness 74e86e1a (navigation, no claim). Priority 6 good-directed probe in docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md: two local zero-axiom checks distinguish a responsive policy from an indifferent propensity while matching a cue-sensitive policy on aligned settings. An independently varied false cue distinguishes a specific channel; it does not resolve ownership of reasons. Holder-root identification now has a conditional route via NAR (43651417).
blocker: No independent warrant was found that a being with an invariant, patientless set-up cannot have a non-rational indeterministic propensity; DNP-prime's inductive base meets a live, interpretation-dependent objection from stochastic quantum dynamics, which undercuts DNP_inv's inherited support though it is not a counterexample to it. Reopen on a reason specific to invariant sources, on strong evidence for deterministic fundamental dynamics, or on independent warrant for the common root’s intellect and the conditions of the registered holder-root identification. A good-sensitive impersonal policy remains live absent a source-specific reason-content and governance bridge.
